summary: Russia escalated multi-axis drone and missile strikes across northern and eastern Ukraine, with 10+ UAVs targeting Korop, Geran-5 rockets hitting Kyiv/Vyshgorod and Obukhov, and reactive drones transiting the Chernobyl exclusion zone toward Zhytomyr. Ukraine intensified oil refinery strikes, disabling 51%+ of Russian refining capacity, while deploying 12 AI turrets in Kyiv against Shaheds. ISW assesses Putin launched early energy strikes to break civilian morale before Ukrainian countermeasures mature.

sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting multi-axis drone incursions from Sumy toward Chernihiv with 10+ regular UAVs and reactive drones targeting Korop, Slavutych, and Konotop, while tactical aviation launches guided aerial bombs on Chernihiv and Zaporizhzhia fronts. Simultaneously, Geran-5 rockets target Kyiv, Vyshgorod, Obukhov, and Zhytomyr Korosten district, and reactive UAVs transit the Chernobyl exclusion zone. Ukraine's intensified strikes have disabled 51%+ of Russian refining capacity, prompting Moscow to escalate energy infrastructure attacks earlier than usual, with ISW assessing Putin aims to break civilian morale. The Northern Bridge damage complicates Kyiv logistics, while 12 AI turrets represent a new defensive layer against jet-powered Shaheds.
